::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 10 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (1) P. 447
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
I shall certainly be here between 3& 5 on Friday, unless something quite unforeseen falls out, and be very glad to see you.

Yours very faithfully
[A. Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
